model: HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct (Apache-2.0), bf16, CPU, 2x2 grid of the first 4 listing photos at 512px
sources: Hagerty Media, 'What does a car's condition really look like?': https://www.hagerty.com/media/market-trends/hagerty-insider/what-does-a-cars-condition-really-look-like/
prompt: These are listing photos of one collector car. Rate its condition on the Hagerty scale. #1 Concours: best in the world, flawless, mirror-like paint and chrome, correct materials. #2 Excellent: could win a local or regional show; only a seasoned observer finds flaws. #3 Good: drives well, no flaws visible to a casual passerby but minor wear up close or some incorrect parts. #4 Fair: daily driver with flaws visible to the naked eye such as pitted chrome, chipped glass, dents, imperfect paint, split seams or cracked dash, possibly non-stock additions. Also judge originality: original (factory-stock parts, wheels, trim and interior) or modified (aftermarket wheels, suspension, engine, custom paint or interior).
readout: condition = expected rating from the softmax over tokens '1'..'4' after 'Condition: #'; confidence = max of that distribution; originality = P(' original') vs P(' modified') after 'Originality:'; reason = greedy 40-token continuation after 'Reason:'
